entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 26311: position at J1991.25; Gaia cannot see the star. Distance: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, HIP 26311: the Hipparcos parallax (van Leeuwen 2007) the radius is computed with, 1.65 +/- 0.45 mas, inverted (https://doi.org/10.1134/S1063773712050015): 606.061 +/- 165.289 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star. Proper motion: VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 26311 (same row): 1.44, -0.78 mas/yr. Radial velocity from Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331, XHIP, HIP 26311: RV 27.3 +/- 0.8 km/s (quality A).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 45 +/- 13 solar radii from Computed here, not printed by a paper: 45 +/- 13 solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.69 +/- 0.04 mas of Hanbury Brown, Davis & Allen (1974), MNRAS 167, 121 (the Narrabri intensity interferometer; Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, Table 1, and the JMDC) and the Hipparcos parallax 1.65 +/- 0.45 mas (van Leeuwen 2007, XHIP) (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/167.1.121). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 24820 +/- 920 K from Code, Davis, Bless & Hanbury Brown (1976), ApJ 203, 417, HD 37128: effective temperature 24820 +/- 920 K (Table 6), from the measured angular diameter and the star's flux from the ultraviolet to the infrared.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: Kharitonov, Tereshchenko & Knyazeva (1988), Spectrophotometric Catalogue of Stars (Alma-Ata), record 381: HR 1903; VizieR III/202, cross-checked against Burnashev (1985), Abastumani Astrophys. Obs. Bull. 59, 83; VizieR III/126, part2 record 66 (BS 1903) (8 levels apart at most, the threshold is 12), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #a6c1ff. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 37128 is not in the library; gaia-xp: the star is placed by a catalogue row, so no Gaia DR3 source is read for it; pulkovo: HR 1903 is not in the catalogue; kiehling: HR 1903 is not among its 60 stars; kharitonov: used.
